dedupe_keys.name: nuclear physics thematic database 核物理主题数据库 evaluated decay fission yield and nuclide data from the china nuclear data center

description: The Nuclear Physics Thematic Database is a Chinese nuclear data service supported by the National Basic Science Data Center, with contacts at the China Institute of Atomic Energy in Beijing. Its introduction states that it holds nuclear structure and nuclear reaction data needed for nuclear science research and nuclear energy development, motivated by the growth of Chinese nuclear power. The catalogue lists evaluated nuclear data, decay data, a thorium-uranium cycle nuclear data library, nuclide properties, experimental nuclear data, fission yields, common decay data, nuclear astrophysics and medical isotope databases. The evaluated database gathers the five international evaluated neutron libraries in ENDF-6 format, for incident neutrons from 10^-5 eV to 20 MeV, with resonance parameters, cross sections, angular and energy distributions and some covariances; CENDL-TMSR, built with the Shanghai Institute of Applied Physics for thorium molten salt reactor design, has neutron data for 405 nuclides, about 1,100 fission products and decay data for 54 nuclides; and a 2006 chart of nuclides from Chinese and Russian collaboration gives basic data for all known nuclides. Coverage is global nuclear data. Access is free through search pages; no licence is stated. Caveats: the site is dated and mostly in Chinese, and it feeds codes, not describing facilities. Simulation uses are neutron transport and depletion inputs for reactor and molten salt reactor design and safety codes. Related records: data-iaea-nuclear-data-services is the IAEA counterpart.
